analyst.summary: TARIL makes power transformers for India's electricity transmission and distribution buildout, and recent quarters show real, profitable growth (16% operating margin, strong production volumes). The eye-catching multi-year profit growth rate partly reflects recovery from a weak base years ago rather than a repeatable pace, and a recent monitoring disclosure flags slower-than-planned utilization of funds raised for expansion. The stock has already corrected meaningfully from its highs. We rate it a Hold: a real sector tailwind and solid current execution, balanced against valuation, promoter dilution, and an execution-pace flag.
